title: Board View cards always show number, unit and status
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view (check in Settings > Roles & Permissions > open your role > Work Orders section). The Admin role has both.
  2. Use a desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  3. In the top bar, choose the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Create everything below in this location.
  4. Make sure the location has the technicians this case uses (e.g. "Esther Howard"). A person only counts as a technician here when the staff record is Active, Clockable is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member > enter the first and last name (e.g. Esther Howard), role Technician, Clockable on, Active, enrolled at this location > Save.
  5. Create the work orders this case uses and set their lead technician (e.g. S1-702 with unit TRK-118 and S1-472 with an asset that has no unit number, both led by Esther Howard):
    • Work Orders > New Work Order > choose a customer (e.g. "Fibridge Commercial") and an asset (e.g. unit TRK-118, 2022 Freightliner M2) > Create. Write down the number the build gives the work order (the numbers in this case are examples).
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician (e.g. Esther Howard) and save. Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. Click the All tab on the left of the toolbar.
  3. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Board View (in the design its tooltip reads "Board").
  4. Open the Fields to display picker (same toolbar place as the Columns button in List and Tech View).
  5. Try to turn off work order number, unit number and status.
  6. Turn off every other field and close the picker.
  7. Read the S1-702 and S1-472 cards.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Work order number, unit number and status cannot be turned off in the picker.
  • With every other field off, the S1-702 card still shows S1-702, TRK-118 and its status.
  • The S1-472 card shows S1-472 and its status, and no unit number because it has none.
  • The design has no Fields to display picker on Board View: if the build has none, it is a fail.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View — board by lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S3-R4, S5-R3, read 8 Oct 2026. Design: Claude Design export of 8 Oct 2026 (Work Orders.dc.html), Board toolbar (no Fields to display picker in the design); on-screen labels only.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R4: “Board View cards include the mandatory fields specified in S5-R3.”
  • S5-R3: “Work order number, unit number when present, and status are mandatory and cannot be deselected.”
